subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session `openclaw agent` CLI dispatches return a terminal lane-busy result after the wait threshold, and what exit-code contract should scripts receive?
rationale: The bug is real, but the permanent CLI/Gateway behavior changes operator-visible delivery semantics and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Adopt CLI Busy Result
options.body: Repair the linked PR and make intended CLI calls return a structured lane-busy result with an actionable message and documented exit behavior.

options.title: Message Only, Keep Generic Exit
options.body: Surface a clear stderr/JSON diagnostic but keep the existing generic exit code if compatibility for scripts matters more than machine-distinguishable busy failures.

options.title: Keep Queueing Semantics
options.body: Decline terminal busy rejection and instead improve progress/timeout diagnostics while preserving current queued execution behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLI Busy Result
recommendation.body: Repair the linked PR and make intended CLI calls return a structured lane-busy result with an actionable message and documented exit behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical Gateway-backed CLI route points to this owner path, and the decision is about the CLI/Gateway contract introduced there.
